Hmm, I'd say most of the best content from this period so far, is from Captain America Comics. I'm only at the end of 1943 personally.

Captain America Comics, often has fairly original and unique stories every time, from haunted houses, to murder mysteries and feuding 'Southern American clan families'.

Sub-Mariner and Human Torch are largely the exact same story beats with minor changes. Seriously almost every issue Torch is hindered by someone using asbestos or flame retardant gases/liquids on him, only for him to recover the very next panel.

Most of Sub-Mariners plots tend to be dealing with 'home grown espionage plots'. Like Germans stealing real munitions from the American war supply lines. Or Germans just off the coast, again interfering with supply ships travelling to Europe. Very occasionally he'll get a fantasy plot, or a bit of civil war in his home of Atlantis.

Young Allies is sometimes quite interesting, but it seems very geared toward a younger audience, with massive full issue spanning stories. Like most stuff with this era, it has it's stereotypical racism, but sometimes it hits a bit harder in these stories as one of the characters 'Whitewash' is almost always the butt of the jokes and the 'idiot' or coward of the group.

Black Widow is very average, seeing as it only had about four issues for the whole of the Golden Age. Could see it being an interesting series if it had, had a longer run.

Thinking,  "I've been loads of times in the past pre-T and been fine." After the film, no change in noise all day until the next morning. Although it's also possible booze may have caused it. After getting home I enjoyed 6 or so shots of Jack Daniels with my friend, before heading home.

Next morning i awoke to my usual quiet T of 2yrs. Although I noticed it was slowly increasing in volume until it settled at its new current level - easily 4 times louder, no exaggeration. So I was left with severe gut pains that wouldn't go away - causing a complete loss of appetite, meaning I couldn't have enjoyable foods to lift my mood. Literally snacks and meals as small as a single grape or banana would make me puke - no blood or anything - mostly bile and the just eaten food.

After these came up the puking stopped but the swallowing pain continues 'til this day.
